part_writes_nothing: Fetching a selected MIME part changes no mailbox.
get_checked_without_identity_unchanged: A whole-message read without supplied UIDVALIDITY is the original read plan.
checked_classify_pin_identity: A classification read with UIDVALIDITY checks it immediately after EXAMINE.
checked_reads_without_identity_unchanged: Header and classification reads without UIDVALIDITY retain their original plans.
checked_read_expectation: A known UIDVALIDITY produces its exact expectation; an unknown one produces none.
checked_read_session_order: A known identity check immediately follows EXAMINE, before the remaining read commands.
checked_read_without_identities_unchange: Wrapping a read plan with no known identities preserves every command.
checked_headers_write_nothing: Identity-checked header reads change no mailbox.
checked_classify_writes_nothing: Identity-checked classification reads change no mailbox.
uid_set_is_comma_joined: UID wire sets are the comma-joined supplied UIDs in their original order.
select_renders_callers_folder: SELECT renders the supplied folder exactly.
copy_renders_exactly: COPY renders a UID COPY with the supplied UIDs and destination.
move_renders_exactly: MOVE renders a UID MOVE with the supplied UIDs and destination.
fetch_renders_exactly: FETCH renders a UID FETCH with the supplied UIDs and fetch items.
guard_search_renders_exact_uids: A UID identity search renders exactly the supplied UID set.
store_renders_exactly: STORE renders UID STORE with the supplied UIDs, operation and flag.
mark_opens_callers_folder: A mark plan opens the caller's exact folder and has no later folder switch.
flag_opens_callers_folder: A flag plan opens the caller's exact folder and has no later folder switch.
unflag_opens_callers_folder: An unflag plan opens the caller's exact folder and has no later folder switch.
move_opens_callers_folder: A move plan opens the caller's exact folder and has no later folder switch.
trash_opens_callers_folder: A trash plan opens the caller's exact folder and has no later folder switch.
label_opens_callers_folder: A label plan opens the caller's exact folder and has no later folder switch.
delete_opens_callers_folder: A confirmed delete plan opens the caller's exact folder and has no later folder switch.
prefix_fits_allowance: The serialized escaped prefix fits its natural-number byte allowance without a counter-overflow premise.
image_bind_count_cap: The production image-binding transitions preserve the four-image cap from their empty seed.
image_bind_byte_cap: The production image-binding transitions preserve the stripped-byte cap under the explicit byte-counter premise.
prefix_whole_when_room: Enough unbounded wire-byte allowance preserves the whole string and exact remainder.
brief_preserves_selected_uids: Brief classification retains the selected UID sequence and its multiplicity.
brief_partitions_selected_uids: Brief classification assigns each selected item to exactly one group.
brief_plans_write_nothing: Brief header plans change no mailbox.
awaiting_disabled_filters_keep_candidate: Disabled awaiting-reply filters never remove a sampled candidate.
brief_complete_unseen_highwater: A complete unseen snapshot advances to its high-water boundary only after all selected items fit.
brief_partial_unseen_prefix: A partial unseen snapshot advances only through its retained prefix.
brief_arrivals_keep_prefix: An arrivals brief keeps its retained prefix and corresponding continuation.
json_serialized_bytes: The serializer and response-size counter agree modulo 2^32 for every JSON value.
brief_range_writes_nothing: A brief range-search plan changes no mailbox.
brief_range_wire: A brief range-search plan renders its exact UID interval and search mode.
brief_completed_has_no_continuation: A completed brief range has no continuation cursor.
brief_unseen_filter_interval: Unseen filtering keeps only UIDs in the requested interval.
